prompt:
# Stiletto: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10026/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully repaint the original isolated and mechanically upright MM9 PCX, which is binding for the design. Preserve the extremely narrow continuous needle-point steel blade, wide low gold oval guard, red/pale/gold banded grip, and round gold pommel. Render one complete vertical Stiletto in restrained MM6-MM8 inventory style on genuine transparent alpha. Do not blunt, break, broaden, or redesign the blade..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: Faithfully repaint the original isolated and mechanically upright MM9 PCX, which is binding for the design. Preserve the extremely narrow continuous needle-point steel blade, wide low gold oval guard, red/pale/gold banded grip, and round gold pommel. Render one complete vertical Stiletto in restrained MM6-MM8 inventory style on genuine transparent alpha. Do not blunt, break, broaden, or redesign the blade.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10026/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Input order: image 1 is paint_mask_guide.png, the edit target. Image 2 is design_reference.png, appearance reference. Image 3 is icon_x8.png, colour reference. Output the full atlas, not a single sword. Preserve the guide's tiny end-on views and all exact placements. 1536x2048 transparent PNG.
CORRECTION: The prior attempt broadened the needle blades and introduced ragged stray pixels. Strictly preserve the original guide silhouette, particularly the hair-thin horizontal blades, with clean edges and no extra pixels outside. Do not turn the blade into a broad triangular sword. Material mask must distinguish red leather grip bands as pure GREEN #00FF00 and pale bone grip bands as pure YELLOW #FFFF00, while all steel blades and gold guard, gold collars and gold pommel are pure RED #FF0000. No shading on mask. Paint top half without metallic highlights, just unlit material colour. Preserve full original 3:4 canvas and exact guide positions.
